title: Kea loader error toasts: automatic via loadersPlugin, opt out via allow-lists in initKea.ts
answers: How do errors toast for kea loaders?
How do I suppress the automatic error toast for a loader?
body:
- Failed loader actions toast automatically from the `loadersPlugin` config in `frontend/src/initKea.ts`. Non-2xx responses toast, except 200/201/204/401/409, and except 403 on `load*` actions.
- To skip the auto toast, add the action key to `ERROR_FILTER_ALLOW_LIST` with a comment saying why. Existing entries include `loadBilling` and `loadRecordingMeta`.
- `ACCESS_DENIED_SELF_HANDLED` is for when only 403 is handled (`saveFeatureFlag`). `NOT_FOUND_SELF_HANDLED` is for when a 404 is an expected state (`loadLineage`).
- For custom failure behaviour, listen to `loadFooFailure`.
- Do not try/catch inside a loader handler: it swallows the error before `loadFooFailure` fires. Listeners and handlers that catch on purpose show `lemonToast.error(...)` (e.g. `dashboardLogic.tsx` ~1712-1777).
- Success toasts go inside the handler after the call succeeds (`revokeSession` in `scenes/settings/user/loginSessionsLogic.ts`).
applies: Applies to kea-loaders actions. Allow-list and self-handled names come from the skill references; only the ERROR_FILTER_ALLOW_LIST grep was partially seen in the trace.
